signal: Solutionreach continues to push patient-engagement automation, citing 20-30% reductions in no-shows through automated reminders and scheduling

email.body1:
Samuel, Solutionreach's whole pitch is automating patient engagement to cut no-shows 20 to 30 percent, yet most RevOps teams are still doing outbound by hand.

That mismatch creates more in-market accounts than the team can act on, and signal-to-action latency is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR turns signals into researched, personalized outreach autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep, every email auto-logged to your CRM.

I built a signal play for Solutionreach off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Samuel, quick follow-up for Solutionreach.

The gap most RevOps leaders fight is speed: a signal fires, but a rep doesn't touch the account for days, so it cools. Tightening that loop with our best practices typically lifts response rates 50 to 70 percent.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I'd change to cut that latency for Solutionreach.
email.body3:
Samuel, last bit of proof for Solutionreach.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Solutionreach's reply rate likely compares to similar B2B teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Samuel, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If cutting signal-to-action latency without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Running a busy healthcare GTM motion is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your RevOps motion? I'll tailor it to Solutionreach either way.
